title: Flutter developer interview in Lahore, Urdu mixed with English

brief.title: Flutter Developer at Nuqta Labs
brief.goals: Show the Ghar Dekho app; ask about the team size
brief.not_done: Salary and notice period not discussed
brief.instructions: Keep it simple. I know Riverpod only a little.

documents.title: CV
documents.text:
Ayesha Siddiqui. Flutter developer, 3 years. Dart, Flutter, Firebase, REST APIs, Bloc.
2022-2025 Ghar Dekho, Lahore: built the property listing app; 100,000 downloads on Play Store, rating 4.6.
Freelance: two booking apps for clinics in Gujranwala.
BS Computer Science, University of the Punjab, 2022.
Notice period: two weeks.

events.text: Walaikum assalam Ayesha. Chalein shuru karte hain. Pehle yeh bata dein, aap ki salary expectation kya hai?
events.reference:
Pehle is role ki range sunna chahungi.
- **Open**: sahi team ke liye flexible
Say next: Is role ki range kya rakhi hai?
Roman Urdu: Woh aap ki tankhwah ki tawaqqo pooch rahe hain.

events.text: Main 180,000 rupay mahana expect kar rahi hoon.
Theek hai. Ghar Dekho wali app ke bare mein batayein, aap ka kya role tha?
events.reference:
Property listing app poori Flutter mein banayi.
- **Reach**: 100,000 downloads on Play Store
- **Quality**: rating 4.6
Roman Urdu: Woh Ghar Dekho app mein aap ka kaam pooch rahe hain.

events.text: Main ne poori listing app banayi thi, 100,000 downloads aur 4.6 rating.
State management ke liye kya use karti hain, Bloc ya Riverpod?
events.reference:
Zyada tar Bloc.
- **Bloc**: Ghar Dekho app mein
- **Riverpod**: basics aate hain, production mein nahi
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke aap state management ke liye kya use karti hain.

bad.answer:
I use Riverpod in all my production apps.
- **Riverpod**: Ghar Dekho

events.text: Zyada tar Bloc. Riverpod thora sa seekha hai.
Accha, main yeh note kar leta hoon ke Riverpod pe thora kaam karna hoga.

bad.answer: Ji bilkul, main jaldi seekh loon gi.

events.text: Hamari team hybrid hai, hafte mein teen din office aana hota hai.
Aap ko office aane mein koi masla to nahi?
events.reference:
Koi masla nahi.
- **Hybrid**: hafte mein teen din theek hain
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke office aane mein koi masla to nahi.

bad.answer:
Koi masla nahi, main pichle paanch saal se hybrid kaam kar rahi hoon.
Roman Urdu: Woh office aane ka pooch rahe hain.

events.text: Ek baar phir Ghar Dekho app ka scale bata dein, downloads kitne the?
events.reference:
Taqreeban 100,000 downloads on Play Store.
- **Rating**: 4.6
Roman Urdu: Woh dobara app ke downloads pooch rahe hain.

events.text: Aur salary ke liye aap ne kitna bataya tha? Main form mein likh raha hoon.
events.reference:
Main ne 180,000 rupay mahana bataya tha.
- **Expectation**: 180,000 PKR monthly
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke aap ne kitni salary batayi thi.

events.text: Notice period kitna hai aap ka?
events.reference:
Do hafte.
- **Start**: offer ke two weeks baad join kar sakti hoon
Roman Urdu: Woh aap ka notice period pooch rahe hain.

events.text: Koi sawal hai aap ka hum se?
events.reference:
Ji, ek sawal.
- **Team**: Flutter team mein kitne log hain?
Say next: Mera pehla project kya hoga?
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke aap ka koi sawal hai.

bad.answer: Office mein kitna aana hoga, yeh bataiye.
